cases.name: Amy Vesta Bryant
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Born in Pasadena Texas, May 19, 1989, Amy excelled in in all walks of life, school, work, and motherhood. Her favorite pastime was soccer, and she played on the Varsity team as a sophomore at Foster High School in Richmond, where she graduated in 2007. Amy ran with the speed and smoothness of deer, she glided across the field, and was thing of beauty to watch. Amy worked hard to get her Associates degree from Wharton Junior College, usually working at the same time as she was taking classes. She excelled on the job also, as she quickly went up the ladder at two retailers to management positions. She recently completed a Dental Assistant certificate program and was working as a Dental Assistant at the time of her death. She loved chatting for hours with her mom, who was also her best friend. She loved hearing her Dad’s old stories. She loved her two brothers like nobody can imagine. Amy’s life hit new heights when her precious son, Mason Hunter, was born on July 13, 2017."
